## Change

What problem does this solve, and what will users see? Link related issues or test reports.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. Documentation-only changes can state that no runtime behavior changed.

## Hardware tested and remaining limitations

Include the exact app/commit, console firmware, payload and other relevant software versions. Distinguish real hardware from simulation or offline checks. For compatibility changes, link the reproducible report and specify which features passed, failed or remain untested.
